next_escalation: If this work order remains OPEN, implement the listed artifact executor with the exact source/target/model/comparator/falsifier fields; do not promote broad superiority.
no_fake_closure_policy: A scoring work order is not scoring evidence. It narrows the research task and cannot close modern_science_comparator_superiority until its evidence pack passes.
pass_predicate: oc_prediction_scoring_row PASS requires executable evidence, existing evidence ref, material OC margin over comparator, no fail-closed status, then replay_record PASS.

required_next_artifacts.pass_predicate: Open/free source snapshot exists locally, is hash-bound, and satisfies source separation policy.

required_source.requirement: Acquire and hash OpenML Curated Classification benchmark suite 2018 from https://www.openml.org/api/v1/json/study/99.

required_next_artifacts.pass_predicate: Target table is locked before scoring and hidden fields do not leak into model selection.

required_target.requirement: Test labels and final fold metrics are sealed until all candidate model outputs are written.
required_target.unit: balanced accuracy error or multiclass log-loss on official holdout fold

required_next_artifacts.pass_predicate: OC prediction/scoring rule is preregistered before target unsealing.

required_model.requirement: Select the model family and hyperparameters using only training/validation folds from a fixed manifest of logistic regression, random forest, and gradient boosting candidates, then score the heldout fold once.

required_next_artifacts.pass_predicate: Incumbent comparator is scored on the same held-out targets.

required_comparator.baseline_name: OpenML dummy, majority, logistic-regression, and random-forest baselines
required_comparator.requirement: Score preregistered DummyClassifier, majority-class, logistic-regression, and random-forest baselines on the same task folds; compare against the strongest admissible baseline.

required_next_artifacts.pass_predicate: OC residual advantage exceeds preregistered materiality threshold under uncertainty.

required_uncertainty.metric: per-task generalization residual: 1 - balanced_accuracy, with log-loss as secondary metric
required_uncertainty.requirement: paired bootstrap over tasks/folds plus binomial label uncertainty for accuracy

required_next_artifacts.pass_predicate: Negative controls and falsifiers are declared and replayed without post-hoc adjustment.

required_falsifier.requirement: Holdout labels leak into model selection, fewer than 20 tasks/folds are scored, comparator ties or beats within uncertainty, or any OpenML task/version hash changes.

required_next_artifacts.pass_predicate: Clean replay regenerates the evidence pack hash and result verdict.

why_it_failed: The lane declares no executable evidence pack for the OC-vs-comparator scoring row.
